description: Header file defining OpenGL 3.1 entry point functions for the ANGLE project, including function declarations for buffer copying, drawing, uniform management, and buffer binding.

methods.name: CopyBufferSubData
methods.description: Copies a subset of data from one buffer to another in OpenGL.

methods.name: DrawArraysInstanced
methods.description: Draws multiple instances of a range of geometric primitives.

methods.name: DrawElementsInstanced
methods.description: Draws multiple instances of a set of elements.

methods.name: GetActiveUniformBlockName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of an active uniform block within a program.

methods.name: GetActiveUniformBlockiv
methods.description: Retrieves parameters of an active uniform block.

methods.name: GetActiveUniformName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of an active uniform variable.

methods.name: GetActiveUniformsiv
methods.description: Retrieves parameters for multiple active uniforms.

methods.name: GetUniformBlockIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a uniform block within a program.

methods.name: PrimitiveRestartIndex
methods.description: Specifies the index to restart primitive assembly.

methods.name: TexBuffer
methods.description: Associates a buffer object with a texture buffer.

methods.name: UniformBlockBinding
methods.description: Binds a uniform block to a binding point.
